dependency_text: The birth choices, closures and counts of LOCAL-COMMUTE; the maximum's matching at the ring (MOST-FAILING); the four-knot closure's qubit reading (TOY-PHASE); the separability argument for readers whom no knot joins (THIRD-READER).
objective: At the owner's go-ahead ("Let's take on 1") on direction 1 of MOST-FAILING-20261127-001: at each of the 1,177 grown closures where birth choices attain an odd close (LOCAL-COMMUTE-20261127-001), search the odd birth choices exactly for a split into readers: sets of distinctions whose values commute with every other reader's, with no knot holding two values of one reader; strictly, each reader holding two values that fail to commute. Count where splits exist and their fewest readers, verify each by a realization local to the readers, and repeat on the 173 finished census types. G18 Comparing growth laws. Stop when every frozen prediction is scored.
status: Complete 2026-11-27 (capability gained; exact searches with a certificate per split; referee pending): some odd birth choice splits into separated readers at 731 of the 1,177 grown closures (one vote per census start), strictly (two failing values per reader) at 692, at none of the other 446; strict splits with three readers exactly at the 423 closures with four mutually meeting knots, five at 17 with a ring of five around a knot; P1 (odd rings only) refuted: 252 split strictly without one, 198 in one shape encoding one reader into two; census types 115 strict, 30 other only, 28 none.
stop_rule: Stop when every frozen prediction is scored; no growth law is changed.
title: Readers on grown closures: do the odd birth choices split into separated readers?
